resend.emailInvalid: Enter the email you signed up with.
resend.sent: If {email} is waiting for confirmation, a new link is on its way. Check your inbox.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.description: Confirmation links work for 24 hours. Get a new one below.

invalid.title: This link doesn't work
invalid.description: It may be incomplete or already used. Get a new one below.

pending.title: Check your inbox
pending.description: Open the link we emailed you to finish signing up. Nothing there? Send it again.
pending.sentTo: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to start playing.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email, and we'll send you a link to choose a new one.

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.description: If an account uses {email}, a reset link is on its way. It works once, for an hour.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.description: You'll be signed out everywhere, then sign in with the new one.
resetPassword.passwordHint: 10 to 128 characters. A few words make a good one.

done.title: Password changed
done.description: Every session has been signed out. Sign in with your new password.

invalid.title: This link doesn't work
invalid.description: Reset links work once, for an hour. Ask for a new one.
